name: OMH Landing Kits For Elementor
author: Online Marketing Help

sections.description:
Easily import and manage custom Elementor templates. Features include uploading, previewing, and importing JSON template files directly into your Elementor library.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/omh-landing-kits-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the OMH Templates menu in your WordPress admin to start importing templates.
sections.faq:
What file types are supported?

Only valid Elementor JSON template files are supported.

Is Elementor required?

Yes, Elementor must be installed and activated for this plugin to work.
